What happens directly after PIBA approval?
Shalom everyone,

Sorry if this is a silly question, but I am very confused about the exact step after PIBA invites me into Israel. My husband has an appointment in September to turn in the physical documents, which if everything goes well I am supposed to receive my entry invitation after this.

The part I'm confused about is whether I'll have to go to the Israeli Embassy in Sweden to receive the entry visa physically in my passport, or whether I can just hop on a flight to Israel after getting the confirmation mail from PIBA?

I was under the impression that I could just fly to Israel, however last week I read something about getting a physical visa attached to my passport at the Israeli Embassy here? But then I read somewhere again today that you don't need anything other than the invitation email from PIBA?

Thank you for any help🤲🏻
